name: task
description: Defines, breaks down and routes tasks before they are executed — observable goal, acceptance criteria and who executes each piece — and keeps the decisions the user has to take apart from them, recording both with the chreos CLI. Also drives a task's lifecycle: opening it to work on, recording progress, verifying and closing it. Use when the user says "we need to do X", "note this task down", "break this down", "where do I start", "what's next", when a choice has to be made before work can go on, or when starting or finishing work on a task.
